notes.title: Explosive Update: MHS now with New Multiplayer!
notes.notes:
You asked... and we delivered!
The biggest update of all time is on the air!

🔥 Instant multiplayer: enter rooms in seconds and face real players!
🚗 Full customization: customize your car your way – faster, more furious, more fun!
💣 New weapons and explosions: shootouts, bombs and nitros that turn every race into pure adrenaline!
📚 Math with action: solve calculations to gain advantage and show that brain also wins race!

Enough playing alone. Enough waiting line.
Now it's you, your reflexes, your intelligence. 🔥🔥🔥

👉 Update now.
👉 Call friends.
👉 Win with strategy, speed and reasoning!

🎮 MHS – Math High Speed
More than a game... it is a revolution on wheels!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TIKbi5ESCW8

notes.title: Math High Speed: The New Update is coming!
notes.notes:
New Version of MHS

[previewyoutube=_X0JWLGogmc;full][/previewyoutube]

Math High Speed is even better! With a new update, we bring more practicality, customization and comfort to your experience. Now, ScrollView saves your position, you can navigate with the mouse scroll and customize your car with just one click. All this to make the game even more fun and dynamic. Stay tuned and get ready for this new version of MHS!
